title: Implement Console target resolver
description:
Implement deterministic Console score target resolution and tests.

Implementation notes:
- Add a runtime score resolve API for unique, ambiguous, and missing targets.
- Teach Console orchestration to consume a prior disambiguation answer once.
- Preserve score edit and guidelines validation safety boundaries.
- Prove with targeted tests and live Console smoke evidence.

No client-specific names or score identifiers are stored here.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting implementation. Current focus: add a deterministic runtime target resolver, update Console follow-up handling, and verify with targeted tests plus a live Console smoke run. No client-specific target names will be recorded in Kanbus.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented deterministic Console target/version fixes and verified with local runtime plus Chrome Console smoke. Added guard so Console guidelines-only score.update requires explicit guidelines intent, updated Console prompt to use score.resolve before score.edit, fixed score.info version alias handling, and confirmed a non-champion candidate edit path with automatic smoke testing. No client-specific details recorded.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Additional realistic Chrome integration run completed with local console worker. Verified three user-style scenarios: (1) missing target -> assistant asked for scorecard/score and did not guess, (2) explicit guidelines wording request -> attempted guidelines update and validation blocked save, (3) explicit scoring-behavior request -> routed through resolve then score.edit and created a non-champion candidate version with expected parent linkage. Also verified score.info(version=...) now resolves specific versions correctly.
